articles.summary: CircuitHub is a software based, full turn-key electronics manufacturing platform. We offer PCB assembly services, based in the US, while serving customers worldwide. Now you might ask — "There are many other US PCB manufacturers available. What sets CircuitHub apart?" The main difference between CircuitHub and other Contract Manufacturers (CMs) in the market is the technology behind CircuitHub that powers it. This article highlights some of the main factors differentiate us from other existing PCB manufacturing solutions.
